content:
#1 Couple of changes to the nForum:

  1. I’ve reduced the text formatter options to just Text and Markdown+Itex. The old ones are “hidden” in that you can’t use them for new posts (well, you could if you really tried hard) but old posts that used them will still display correctly.

  2. The “Guest Post” facility (which is only enabled in the “latest changes” category) no longer uses the reCaptcha. The reCaptcha has been broken for some time which has effectively meant that guest posts weren’t working. To avoid the spam issue, guest posts are forced to be posted in the Text formatter which escapes all HTML code (and the way to get round the above enforcement doesn’t work for this one).
